description: Cyclone records transcribed from the supplied MOTIS screenshots.
notes: Dates and times are UTC; date_mmdd and time_utc_hhmm preserve the screenshot convention.
pressure is made internally consistent as round(POCI - dP, 1).
Historical coordinates use the matching MOTIS source track coordinate; 2026 coordinates use linear interpolation of the cited IBTrACS/JTWC track.
source_row is the visible screenshot row number when OCR recovered it; it is not part of the requested cyclone fields.
